==================
Module import declaration
==================
import module java.base;
class Probe { int f(boolean x) { return x ? 1 : 0; } }

---

(program
  (import_declaration
    (scoped_identifier
      (identifier)
      (identifier)))
  (class_declaration
    (identifier)
    (class_body
      (method_declaration
        (integral_type)
        (identifier)
        (formal_parameters
          (formal_parameter
            (boolean_type)
            (identifier)))
        (block
          (return_statement
            (ternary_expression
              (identifier)
              (decimal_integer_literal)
              (decimal_integer_literal))))))))

==================
Module remains an ordinary identifier
==================
import module.foo;
import static module.foo.bar;
class Probe { int module(boolean x) { return x ? 1 : 0; } }

---

(program
  (import_declaration
    (scoped_identifier
      (identifier)
      (identifier)))
  (import_declaration
    (scoped_identifier
      (scoped_identifier
        (identifier)
        (identifier))
      (identifier)))
  (class_declaration
    (identifier)
    (class_body
      (method_declaration
        (integral_type)
        (identifier)
        (formal_parameters
          (formal_parameter
            (boolean_type)
            (identifier)))
        (block
          (return_statement
            (ternary_expression
              (identifier)
              (decimal_integer_literal)
              (decimal_integer_literal))))))))
